title: The Bible as Literature
description: Surveys basic stories and books in the Old and New Testaments with a focus on their literary features. Familiarizes students with important biblical stories, genres and references in literature and religious discourse.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 233, ENGL 260, ENGL 365 (if taken prior to December 1983), ENGL 409, RCS 260, RS 260.
